_meta.purpose: Citation-grade reference experiment suite running the latest CNT v3 + CNQ v2 engines across every domain in the DATA folder. These are the definitive worked examples for compositional analysis using the Hs framework. No simulated data; every input is a real-world dataset with a documented source.

headlines.description: Stracke MORB (mid-ocean ridge basalt) major-oxide composition, by ocean basin. T = 5 locations, D = 10 oxide carriers (SiO2, TiO2, Al2O3, FeO, CaO, MgO, MnO, K2O, Na2O, P2O5).
headlines.citation: Stracke A. (2022) — Geochem Earthchem 2022_09-0SVW6S

headlines.description: Chemixhub oxide compositional samples — synthetic-style mineral oxide compositions across 25 catalogued samples; D = 7 oxide carriers.
headlines.citation: ChemixHub project, github.com/chemixhub (oxide composition subset)

headlines.description: ESA Planck cosmological energy-density composition vs redshift. T = 18 redshift bins (z = 0.0 to z = 1100), D = 5 species carriers (Dark Energy, Cold Dark Matter, Baryons, Photons, Neutrinos).
headlines.citation: Planck 2018 cosmological parameters (Planck Collaboration); composition computed at each redshift bin per standard LCDM evolution equations

headlines.description: S&P 500 sector-weight composition, daily for one trading year. T = 252 trading days, D = 10 GICS sectors (Information Tech, Health Care, Financials, Cons Discretionary, Comm Services, Industrials, Cons Staples, Energy, Utilities, Materials).
headlines.citation: S&P Global GICS sector classifications applied to SP500.csv close-prices; sector weighting per S&P methodology

headlines.description: IIASA NGFS Phase-4 scenario emissions allocation by sector. T = 31 years (2020-2050), D = 7 emission-sector carriers (Energy, Transport, Industry, Buildings, Agriculture, LULUCF, Other).
headlines.citation: IIASA NGFS Phase-4 dataset (Network for Greening the Financial System scenarios)

headlines.description: City of Markham (Ontario) operating budget composition, fiscal years 2011-2025. T = 15 fiscal years, D = 8 budget category carriers (Operations & Asset Mgmt, Public Safety, Planning & Building, Recreation & Culture, Library & Heritage, Engineering & Capital, Corporate Services, Council & Administration).
headlines.citation: City of Markham annual budget reports (compiled from public budget documents)

headlines.description: Annual gold-silver mass-fraction composition normalized over both metals, 1688-2025 (T = 1338 years). D = 2 carriers — minimum compositional dimension; the engine handles D = 2 via the degenerate-pair branch.
headlines.citation: Compiled from BoE+Bullion historical price/production records; normalized to a 2-element composition by total-mass weighting

headlines.description: Semi-empirical mass formula (SEMF) component decomposition across the valley of stability. T = 76 nuclides (light to heavy), D = 5 SEMF term carriers (Volume, Surface, Coulomb, Asymmetry, Pairing). The 'time' axis is nuclide ordering by Z+A; each row is one (Z, A) pair.
headlines.citation: AME2020 nuclear masses (Wang et al. 2021); SEMF terms per Weizsäcker formula

headlines.description: Ball (2022) intraplate-volcanic database — major-oxide composition binned by IUGS chronostratigraphic age epoch (Holocene through Eocene_or_older). T = 10 epochs, D = 10 oxides (SiO2, TiO2, Al2O3, FeO, CaO, MgO, MnO, K2O, Na2O, P2O5).
headlines.citation: Ball M.E. et al. (2022) — Geochem Earthchem 2022-3-RY3BRK; chronostratigraphic binning per IUGS chart

headlines.description: Ball (2022) intraplate-volcanic database — major-oxide composition binned by geographic Region (95 regions retained at min n=10 per region). T = 95, D = 10 oxides.
headlines.citation: Ball M.E. et al. (2022) — Geochem Earthchem 2022-3-RY3BRK; region binning per source metadata

headlines.description: Ball (2022) intraplate-volcanic database — major-oxide composition binned by Total-Alkali-Silica (TAS, Le Bas 1986) rock-type classification. T = 15 rock types, D = 10 oxides.
headlines.citation: Ball M.E. et al. (2022) — Geochem Earthchem 2022-3-RY3BRK; TAS classification per Le Bas 1986

headlines.description: Qin et al. (2024) clinopyroxene mineral spot analyses from intra-cratonic mantle xenoliths and ultramafic rocks. T = 30 top locations (>=10 spots each), D = 9 oxides (SiO2, TiO2, Al2O3, Cr2O3, FeO, CaO, MgO, MnO, Na2O — note Cr2O3 replaces K2O for clinopyroxene). Crucial test for whether the K2O-prefix in the helmsman lineage is specifically potassium or 'dominant alkali in general'.
headlines.citation: Qin Y. et al. (2024) — Geochem Earthchem 2024-007_AVAW2Y_Qin_data

headlines.description: Stracke (2022) ocean island basalt (OIB) major-oxide composition, binned by location (top 15 locations by sample count, including Galapagos, Iceland, Hawaii, Tristan da Cunha, etc.). T = 15, D = 10 oxides.
headlines.citation: Stracke A. (2022) — Geochem Earthchem 2022_09-0SVW6S_Stracke_data (OIB subset)

headlines.description: Tappe et al. (2024) Kimberlite Group-1 bulk rock major-oxide composition, binned by country/region. T = 8 countries, D = 10 oxides. Kimberlites are intra-cratonic mantle-derived ultrapotassic rocks; K2O is typically very high (>3% on mass basis).
headlines.citation: Tappe S. et al. (2024) — Geochem Earthchem 2022-2-FLV19S_Tappe_data_v2024

headlines.description: FAO indicator FAO_IC_23068 — Credit to Agriculture, Forestry and Fishing (USD millions). Pivoted compositional view: top-10 countries by total reporting volume, normalised so each year's row is the country-share of total recorded credit. Reveals year-by-year concentration shifts in agricultural lending.
headlines.citation: FAO Aquastat / Credit to Agriculture indicator FAO_IC_23068; top-10 country selection by cumulative reporting volume

headlines.description: FAO indicator FAO_MK_22016 — Value Added in Agriculture, Forestry and Fishing. Top-10 country compositional pivot, 1970-2024 (T = 55 years).
headlines.citation: FAO Macro-Economic Indicators FAO_MK_22016; top-10 country selection

headlines.description: FAO indicator FAO_MK_22010 — Value Added (Agriculture), USD millions. Top-10 country compositional pivot. T years × D = 10 countries; each year's row sums to 1.0 (country-share of agricultural value added among the top-10 reporting nations).
headlines.citation: FAO Macro-Economic Indicators FAO_MK_22010; top-10 country selection by cumulative value added
